evidence.document: JSCJ BZT52 family page 2 type-code table and SOD-123 review

marking.appearance_status: JSCJ family table specifies WO and a cathode bar; the optional green-moulding dot is omitted. Typeface, placement and finish are illustrative. The family PDF is stored with BZT52C10; exact orderable and production marking variation are not independently confirmed.

recipe.appearance_status: KiCad SOD-123 model is 3.8 x 1.6 x 1.26 mm overall; the cathode band is on the pin-1 side. Its height exceeds the local drawing maximum by about 0.01 mm; source dimensions use a different envelope. Fine details are illustrative; not manufacturing CAD or a footprint.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
